context.p: When you export a file in draw.io, it is saved as a non-editable format. You can use this format when you want to share, publish, embed, or use the diagram elsewhere.

step.cmd: On the draw.io editor, click File.
On the menu, click Export as.
On the submenu, click the format you want to export the file in.
In the Image dialog box, make the necessary changes.
In the dialog box that appears, do the following:

substep.cmd: Next to Save as, enter the file name.
Next to Where, click the dropdown to select the location to want the file to be exported in.

taskbody.result: The exported file is saved in the provided location.
